svg.aria-label: Clear the dead attempts, warn before the pause: 1. Schedule: The downloads-janitor CronJob runs daily at 05:30 and mounts the shared-downloads claim at /data/downloads. 2. Clear: It removes _UNPACK_ and _FAILED_ directories untouched for 24 hours, and empty leftover directories older than 7 days. Only depth 2 under usenet/complete is in scope. 3. Warn: Two alerts watch free space. At 15% free it warns; at 7% it goes critical, before SABnzbd's 100G auto-pause trips.
